bugs.name: Contributors chart shows a date range ending in the future
bugs.summary: The repository Contributors chart labels its displayed range as extending several days beyond the current application time, including an `in future` relative label. Reproduced on two repositories after reload.
bugs.expected: The Contributors chart should label historical activity with a range ending at or before the current time, or otherwise present the current incomplete period without a future date/`in future` label.
bugs.actual: On Oct 8, 2026 at about 10:39 AM PDT, the Contributors page displayed `Oct 3, 2026, 05:00 PM PDT - Oct 11, 2026, 10:39 AM PDT` and `4 days ago - in future`. The same future end date appeared on both `momentic-admin/field-notes` and `momentic-admin/BB-projects-repro-20261008`; switching Contribution type to Additions did not change it.
reproSteps: Sign in as momentic-admin and open momentic-admin/field-notes.
Compare the chart range end to the current browser time.
Reload and observe the future end date and relative label; switching Contribution type does not change the range.
bugs.reason: Human review confirmed this is intended behavior. Forgejo v16.0.5 RepoContributors.vue sets xAxisEnd to firstStartDateAfterDate(new Date()); that helper advances to the next Sunday while preserving the time of day. The future range boundary represents the current weekly chart period, not future-dated fixture commits.

bugs.name: At a 768px tablet viewport, the active repository Activity tab label is clipped to “Ac”.
bugs.summary: After selecting Activity from the repository navigation overflow menu at 768px, the report claims its active label is clipped to Ac.
bugs.expected: The Activity navigation label should be readable without clipping.
bugs.actual: The report claims that only Ac appears at the right edge of the navigation row. The submitted screenshot instead shows the full Wiki label followed by the overflow menu, with no Ac fragment.
reproSteps: Sign in with repository access and open momentic-admin/field-notes at a 768 × 1024 viewport.
Open the repository navigation overflow menu and select Activity.
Inspect the repository navigation row and its overflow menu while the Activity page is displayed.
bugs.reason: The submitted screenshot does not show the claimed Ac clipping. Activity is kept in the intended overflow menu at this width; the active item need not move into the main row. The screenshot shows full Wiki followed by the overflow menu, and Activity navigation succeeds. Reject this unsupported clipping claim.
